notes.title: Thanks for the support, new character updates.
notes.notes:
Since it was launched more than a month ago, thanks to everyone's support, our small team received the first funding. This not only strengthened our belief in continuing, but also felt the love of everyone in the I Ching culture.

In order to give back to everyone, this update has added a new character, the Harpy, which is a mobile character characterized by fast movement.
Secondly, the newbie guidance function has been added, so that you don't know what to do after entering the game.
Finally, the character's stats have been adjusted, especially most of the character's movement speed.

Finally, which is currently on sale.

The next update is the Sand Monk Golden Body Arhat Boss and the Little White Dragon Sword Immortal Boss, as well as the I Ching hexagram clearance achievements.

At the same time, we will use storytelling to tell the specific hexagrams and hexagrams of the 60 hexagrams on Station B and YouTube, so as to memorize the I Ching more deeply.

notes.title: "Attack on I-Ching" will be officially released on August 15, 2024!
notes.notes:
In order to allow more lovers of easy learning to be able to memorize the I Ching. We have been planning this game project since 2018. After that, the five editions were overturned and reinvented. It's finally time to meet you. The game adopts meat pigeon + active skill gameplay. Starting from the basic yin and yang, familiarizing yourself with the sixty hexagrams of the I Ching, and finally memorizing the I Ching completely.
After the test of the internal test friends, you will be able to memorize the names and images of the 64 hexagrams in 30 days, and be familiar with the original content of the I Ching, laying a foundation for further learning the more profound content of the I Ching.

The game is 10% off for the first time, and friends who want to exchange I Ching and games can join the exchange group. QQ:625617385。

At the same time, in response to the needs of some UP main live broadcasts, two heroes of the Oriental fandom, Borei Reimu and Marisa Misty Rain, have been added.
